advisoryFindings.title: Add runtime miss check for same-provider profileKey changes
advisoryFindings.improvement: Add a small Agent.call case where SDD_FORGE_PROFILE changes between two profile keys that resolve to the same provider and same invocation, and assert the provider is invoked again.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The key-builder assertions already cover profileKey identity, so the requirement is not uncovered, but a runtime-level check would better match R3's cache-miss behavior claim.
